top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 111, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
The Watermoo's southeast Michigan gravel roads rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
The Watermoo's Gravel roads, Rural Michigan forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 111 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of The Watermoo. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic The Watermoo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
At The Watermoo, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 111 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
111 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,997ft of climbing on southeast Michigan gravel roads does to your power file on race day.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 111 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Tempo is The Watermoo's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 111 miles on southeast Michigan gravel roads. Train it until it's automatic.
Varied gradients on southeast Michigan gravel roads demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for The Watermoo’s 111 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at The Watermoo requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on southeast michigan gravel roads to build confidence. Expect: gravel roads, rural michigan, rolling hills.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 111 miles of southeast michigan gravel roads in Dexter, Michigan.
